complaint: Someone in legal asked yesterday how a party can end the Pressman agreement. The answer cited the wrong termination clause. I don't have a ticket number.

shortlist.question: How much written notice does a party need to give to terminate this agreement?
Can the Company end the agreement without notice if services are deficient?
Where do we send a notice if we terminate the Pressman agreement?
What happens to the indemnity after we end the Pressman contract?
How can either party end the Pressman service agreement?

found_question: How can either party end the Pressman service agreement?
found_answer: Termination is covered by Clause 12.9. Either party may terminate the Service Provider Agreement by giving sixty (60) days' notice to the registered office. Sources: Service-Provider-Agreement.pdf
why_it_is_wrong: Clause 7.1 is the termination right: 30 days' prior written notice. Clause 12.9 only says where a notice is sent. The logged answer treats 12.9 as the termination clause and invents a 60-day period.
decoy_note: The 13:22 log also mentions Clause 12.9 and termination. It is not the failure: it uses 12.9 as the delivery address and still cites Clause 7.1 for the 30-day period.
